_comment: In-app purchases for App Store Connect. Names are the in-game names (tools/strings, key store.<item>); prices come from StoreKit/BalloonBaron.storekit (euros, base territory in config.json). Limits: name 30, description 45.

products.reviewNote: Gold leaf: It is a balloon pattern: after purchase it appears as a ready-made design in the Design Studio and is applied to the flagship balloon. Non-consumable, restorable with "Restore purchases" in the bazaar. The bazaar (shop) opens on game day 11; to get there quickly, play a few days (each day: tap "Collect passengers", take off, land). No login needed.
